description: This Scala source file defines a trait 'MdcEntrySettable' that provides methods for setting and removing MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries in a logger, including multiple overloads for different numbers of entries and a varargs method for bulk entries.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds a single MDC entry identified by a key and value, returning the logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds two MDC entries identified by their keys and values, returning the logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds three MDC entries identified by their keys and values, returning the logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries via varargs, including a primary entry and additional entries, returning the logger instance for chaining.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key, does nothing if the key does not exist.
